events.title: The election of Pope Innocent III
events.shortBlurb: The cardinals chose Lotario dei Conti di Segni, who as Innocent III would raise the medieval papacy to the height of its power…
body: On 8 January 1198 the cardinals elected Lotario dei Conti di Segni, a gifted young Roman cleric and canonist, who took the name Innocent III. Not yet forty, he brought to the office an unmatched grasp of law and government and a lofty vision of the papacy's place in Christendom.

During his pontificate he asserted papal authority over kings and emperors, approved the new orders of St. Francis and St. Dominic, and summoned the Fourth Lateran Council in 1215, one of the most important councils of the Middle Ages. He is often reckoned the most powerful of all the medieval popes.
